title: lolium temulentum subsp. arvense
intro: Lolium temulentum subsp. arvense, commonly known as Darnel or False Oat, is a subspecies of Lolium temulentum, a type of grass-like plant. It is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Lolium temulentum subsp. arvense include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
